verses.en: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
verses.pt: Rogo-vos, pois, eu, o prisioneiro no Senhor, que andeis como é digno da vocação com que fostes chamados,
verses.en_web: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
verses.en_bbe: I then, the prisoner in the Lord, make this request from my heart, that you will see that your behaviour is a credit to the position which God's purpose has given you,

verses.en: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.pt: com toda a humildade e mansidão, com longanimidade, suportando-vos uns aos outros em amor,
verses.en_web: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;
verses.en_bbe: With all gentle and quiet behaviour, taking whatever comes, putting up with one another in love;

verses.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.pt: procurando diligentemente guardar a unidade do Espírito no vínculo da paz.
verses.en_web: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.en_bbe: Taking care to keep the harmony of the Spirit in the yoke of peace.

verses.en: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.pt: Há um só corpo e um só Espírito, como também fostes chamados em uma só esperança da vossa vocação;
verses.en_web: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;
verses.en_bbe: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you have been marked out by God in the one hope of his purpose for you;

verses.en: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.pt: um só Senhor, uma só fé, um só batismo;
verses.en_web: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.en_bbe: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.en: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.pt: um só Deus e Pai de todos, o qual é sobre todos, e por todos e em todos.
verses.en_web: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.
verses.en_bbe: One God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.

verses.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.pt: Mas a cada um de nós foi dada a graça conforme a medida do dom de Cristo.
verses.en_web: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: But to every one of us has grace been given in the measure of the giving of Christ.

verses.en: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
verses.pt: Por isso foi dito: Subindo ao alto, levou cativo o cativeiro, e deu dons aos homens.
verses.en_web: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.”
verses.en_bbe: For this reason he says, He went up on high, taking his prisoners with him, and gave freely to men.

verses.en: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.pt: Ora, isto - ele subiu - que é, senão que também desceu às partes mais baixas da terra?
verses.en_web: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.en_bbe: (Now this, He went up, what is it but that he first went down into the lower parts of the earth?

verses.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.pt: Aquele que desceu é também o mesmo que subiu muito acima de todos os céus, para cumprir todas as coisas.
verses.en_web: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
verses.en_bbe: He who went down is the same who went up far over all the heavens so that he might make all things complete.)

verses.en: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.pt: E ele deu uns como apóstolos, e outros como profetas, e outros como evangelistas, e outros como pastores e mestres,
verses.en_web: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
verses.en_bbe: And he gave some as Apostles, and some, prophets; and some, preachers of the good news; and some to give care and teaching;

verses.en: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
verses.pt: tendo em vista o aperfeiçoamento dos santos, para a obra do ministério, para edificação do corpo de Cristo;
verses.en_web: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;
verses.en_bbe: For the training of the saints as servants in the church, for the building up of the body of Christ:

verses.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
verses.pt: até que todos cheguemos à unidade da fé e do pleno conhecimento do Filho de Deus, ao estado de homem feito, à medida da estatura da plenitude de Cristo;
verses.en_web: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;
verses.en_bbe: Till we all come to the harmony of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to full growth, to the full measure of Christ:

verses.en: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.pt: para que não mais sejamos meninos, inconstantes, levados ao redor por todo vento de doutrina, pela fraudulência dos homens, pela astúcia tendente à maquinação do erro;
verses.en_web: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
verses.en_bbe: So that we may be no longer children, sent this way and that, turned about by every wind of teaching, by the twisting and tricks of men, by the deceits of error;

verses.en: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
verses.pt: antes, seguindo a verdade em amor, cresçamos em tudo naquele que é a cabeça, Cristo,
verses.en_web: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;
verses.en_bbe: But saying true words in love, may come to full growth in him, who is the head, even Christ;

verses.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.pt: do qual o corpo inteiro bem ajustado, e ligado pelo auxílio de todas as juntas, segundo a justa operação de cada parte, efetua o seu crescimento para edificação de si mesmo em amor.
verses.en_web: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
verses.en_bbe: Through whom all the body, being rightly formed and united together, by the full working of every part, is increased to the building up of itself in love.

verses.en: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.pt: Portanto digo isto, e testifico no Senhor, para que não mais andeis como andam os gentios, na verdade da sua mente,
verses.en_web: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
verses.en_bbe: This I say, then, and give witness in the Lord, that you are to go no longer in the way of the Gentiles whose minds are turned to that which has no profit,

verses.en: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
verses.pt: entenebrecidos no entendimento, separados da vida de Deus pela ignorância que há neles, pela dureza do seu coração;
verses.en_web: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;
verses.en_bbe: Whose thoughts are dark, to whom the life of God is strange because they are without knowledge, and their hearts have been made hard;

verses.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.pt: os quais, tendo-se tornado insensíveis, entregaram-se à lascívia para cometerem com avidez toda sorte de impureza.
verses.en_web: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.en_bbe: Who having no more power of feeling, have given themselves up to evil passions, to do all unclean things with overmuch desire.

verses.en: But ye have not so learned Christ;
verses.pt: Mas vós não aprendestes assim a Cristo.
verses.en_web: But you did not learn Christ that way;
verses.en_bbe: For this was not the teaching of Christ which was given to you;

verses.en: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
verses.pt: se é que o ouvistes, e nele fostes instruídos, conforme é a verdade em Jesus,
verses.en_web: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
verses.en_bbe: If in fact you gave ear to him, and were given teaching in him, even as what is true is made clear in Jesus:

verses.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.pt: a despojar-vos, quanto ao procedimento anterior, do velho homem, que se corrompe pelas concupiscências do engano;
verses.en_web: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;
verses.en_bbe: That you are to put away, in relation to your earlier way of life, the old man, which has become evil by love of deceit;

verses.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.pt: a vos renovar no espírito da vossa mente;
verses.en_web: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
verses.en_bbe: And be made new in the spirit of your mind,

verses.en: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
verses.pt: e a vos revestir do novo homem, que segundo Deus foi criado em verdadeira justiça e santidade.
verses.en_web: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
verses.en_bbe: And put on the new man, to which God has given life, in righteousness and a true and holy way of living.

verses.en: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.pt: Pelo que deixai a mentira, e falai a verdade cada um com o seu próximo, pois somos membros uns dos outros.
verses.en_web: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
verses.en_bbe: And so, putting away false words, let everyone say what is true to his neighbour: for we are parts one of another.

verses.en: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.pt: Irai-vos, e não pequeis; não se ponha o sol sobre a vossa ira;
verses.en_web: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
verses.en_bbe: Be angry without doing wrong; let not the sun go down on your wrath;

verses.en: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.pt: nem deis lugar ao Diabo.
verses.en_web: and don’t give place to the devil.
verses.en_bbe: And do not give way to the Evil One.

verses.en: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
verses.pt: Aquele que furtava, não furte mais; antes trabalhe, fazendo com as mãos o que é bom, para que tenha o que repartir com o que tem necessidade.
verses.en_web: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
verses.en_bbe: Let him who was a thief be so no longer, but let him do good work with his hands, so that he may have something to give to him who is in need.

verses.en: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verses.pt: Não saia da vossa boca nenhuma palavra torpe, mas só a que seja boa para a necessária edificação, a fim de que ministre graça aos que a ouvem.
verses.en_web: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
verses.en_bbe: Let no evil talk come out of your mouth, but only what is good for giving necessary teaching, and for grace to those who give ear.

verses.en: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.pt: E não entristeçais o Espírito Santo de Deus, no qual fostes selados para o dia da redenção.
verses.en_web: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.en_bbe: And do not give grief to the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were marked for the day of salvation.

verses.en: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.pt: Toda a amargura, e cólera, e ira, e gritaria, e blasfêmia sejam tiradas dentre vós, bem como toda a malícia.
verses.en_web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.
verses.en_bbe: Let all bitter, sharp and angry feeling, and noise, and evil words, be put away from you, with all unkind acts;

verses.en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
verses.pt: Antes sede bondosos uns para com os outros, compassivos, perdoando-vos uns aos outros, como também Deus vos perdoou em Cristo.
verses.en_web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
verses.en_bbe: And be kind to one another, full of pity, having forgiveness for one another, even as God in Christ had forgiveness for you.
